description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_calibrate instead; removed in v4.0] Aggregate closed-bead actual vs estimated durations per template. Prefers git first-commit ts as work-start proxy (capped at 200 git calls/run; falls back to created_ts when over cap or no commit). Drops samples with clock-skew. Writes report to .pi-flywheel/calibration.json and returns it.

sinceDays.description: Filter to beads created within this many days (1-365, default 90)
